Global-to-local transfer & $\du=|u_{\mathrm{top}}-u_{\mathrm{bottom}}|_{xy}$ across the ball layer and $T_{\mathrm{j}}$ at the critical site, from the package thermoelastic solution on the converged electrothermal field \\
Cycle & 4 cycles of 600~s: 300~s at $T_{\mathrm{j}}$ with $\du$, then 300~s at 25\,$^\circ$C with $u_x = 0$; e.g., Z1 under cooling~A: $\du = 2.21$~\textmu m at 115.0\,$^\circ$C \\
Load application & temperature and displacement change as steps at the start of each half-cycle, applied in a 3-s step and held for 297~s at the same loads (a numerical device only) \\
Time integration & implicit (backward-Euler) viscoplastic update; creep tolerance 0.05 on the change of inelastic strain rate per increment \\
Increments, load step & initial 0.002~s, minimum $10^{-9}$~s, maximum 3~s, at most 5000 \\
Increments, hold step & initial 0.5~s, minimum $10^{-9}$~s, maximum 15~s, at most 5000 \\
Increment checks & halving the initial increment changes $\deps$ by less than 0.03\,\%; the solver does not cut below $10^{-6}$ of the step period (3~\textmu s in the 3-s load step) \\
Response $\deps$ & increment over the last cycle of the volume-averaged accumulated equivalent inelastic strain, $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{eq}}=\sum\sqrt{2/3}\,|\mathrm{d}\varepsilon_{\mathrm{in}}|$, of the solder core; element value the mean of its integration points, volume-weighted \\
Uncertainty of $\deps$ & $U=U_{\mathrm{mesh}}+U_{\mathrm{time}}+U_{\mathrm{cyc}}$ \\

\medskip

\noindent\emph{Limitations of the creep card.}
\begin{itemize}
\item The creep data are for bulk Sn3.9Ag0.6Cu~\cite{Xiao2005SAC}, not for SAC305.
\item The card was fitted to the applied (von~Mises) stress, whereas the solver integrates the overstress $\sigma_{\mathrm{vm}}-\sigma_y$; the card therefore does not reproduce its own calibration data, and the joints creep far above the calibrated stresses (Table~\ref{tab:supp-stress}).
\item Linear interpolation of $A$ between rows makes the creep rate at the critical joints 1.2--3.5 times the intended one (Table~\ref{tab:supp-cardgrid}).
\item Outside $-40$ to 125\,$^\circ$C the solver holds the end rows: a joint at 140.3\,$^\circ$C (Z1, S1) uses the 125-$^\circ$C row.
\item The solver replaces any $A\,t^m$ below $10^{-20}$ by $10^{-20}$, so the $-40$-$^\circ$C row ($A = 4.0\times10^{-22}$) is never used.
\end{itemize}

Package networks, mesh; aligned graded finite-volume sheet & -- & $+0.0453$\,\% & Discretization change of worst of five metrics, levels L2$\to$L3, all four networks at $N = 54$ & self-refinement; says nothing about physical accuracy \\
